Findings triage: **HOLD** (`finding` kept). Verified @ objectui `origin/main` `cb5e32d`: `packages/layout/src/AppShell.tsx:5` still imports `Sidebar`, and the component body uses only `SidebarProvider` / `SidebarInset` (`:247` / `:256` / `:264`) — dead import confirmed.

Not promoted and not folded into a dead-surface sweep yet, because it is coupled to the open decision card **#3946** (AppShell sidebar toggle: docs-align vs code-align): a code-align ruling would have AppShell render sidebar chrome and could revive exactly this import; docs-align makes it a pure deletion. Deleting it now and reviving it next week would be churn on a file under an open ruling.

Restart: #3946's ruling — the deletion (or revival) rides the PR that lands that ruling; if docs-align wins and no code PR materializes, fold into the next dead-surface sweep batch (post-#3931).
